node: Data-center power, grid interconnection, electrical equipment and liquid cooling
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the AI power-grid-cooling node found five US-listed or US-tradable public companies with direct exposure beyond the seed universe. The strongest additions are electrical infrastructure and liquid-cooling suppliers tied to AI data-center power density, grid connection, medium/low-voltage distribution, substation equipment, rack power, and CDU/manifold cooling systems. This is a research universe expansion only, not a recommendation. Seed names such as Vertiv, Eaton, GE Vernova, Quanta Services, Constellation, NextEra and hyperscalers remain relevant; this pass adds adjacent direct suppliers not already emphasized in the seed list.
